title: Prepared dose label cannot be retrieved safely after the preparation session ends
actual: POST /mar/6/prepare200 returns the authoritative dose_label once. After app/session restart, GETMAR18 retains prepared_at/by/preparation for6 but has no printablelabel; the catalogue exposes no GET label endpoint (search dose label yields only POSTprepare). A new prepare is state-refused; replay requires the original key/payload in volatile memory. Our app never invents a replacement label and reports the original unavailable.
expected: Provide a read-only authorised prepared-dose label endpoint (like lab label reprint), or an explicit supported recovery after session restart/24hourkeyretention. Reprinting must not repeat preparation or administration; client must not guess the original label/author/time from partial rows.
